description: Test class for LocalHTTPD server, containing unit tests for HTTP server behavior including file serving, range requests, headers, and error handling.

classes.name: LocalHTTPDTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing LocalHTTPD server functionalities.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops server and cleans up after tests.

methods.name: doTest404
methods.description: Tests server response for non-existent resource (404).

methods.name: doSomeBasicTest
methods.description: Tests basic file serving and directory listing.

methods.name: testAPKMimeType
methods.description: Checks MIME type for APK files.

methods.name: testHeadRequest
methods.description: Tests HEAD request handling and headers.

methods.name: testBadPostRequest
methods.description: Tests server response to malformed POST request.

methods.name: doArgumentTest
methods.description: Tests server response with URL query parameters.

methods.name: testURLContainsParentDirectory
methods.description: Ensures server blocks directory traversal attempts.

methods.name: testIndexFileIsShownWhenURLEndsWithDirectory
methods.description: Checks if index.html is served for directory URLs.

methods.name: testRangeHeaderWithStartPositionOnly
methods.description: Tests partial content response with range header starting at byte 10.

methods.name: testRangeStartGreaterThanFileLength
methods.description: Tests server response for range request beyond file size (416).

methods.name: testRangeHeaderWithStartAndEndPosition
methods.description: Tests partial content response with specific byte range.

methods.name: testIfNoneMatchHeader
methods.description: Tests server's 304 Not Modified response with ETag.

methods.name: testRangeHeaderAndIfNoneMatchHeader
methods.description: Tests priority of headers in combined range and if-none-match request.

methods.name: getNoKeepAliveConnection
methods.description: Helper to create HTTP connection with 'Connection: Close' header.
